name: Plants Vs Fishes 🐠
desc:
🐠 Welcome to Plants vs Fishes!

How to Play:
🌱 Buy a Seed & Plant it in your Garden!
🌻 Your Plants Fight the Fishes!
💸 The Fishes make Money!
🦈 Buy INSANE plants & show off your Fishes to Everyone!

👍 Like the Game and Join the Group for UPDATES!
💻 Game Works on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
